commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+2' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Alberto Moreno plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:2.

90+2' Marcos Pena (Almeria) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The referee is firm and issues Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) a deserved yellow card.
87' It's the second caution for Largie Ramazani (Almeria) and that's the last we'll see of him in this game. There was no other option for Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.

86' A precise low pass is received by Bertrand Traore (Villarreal), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
85' Substitution. Adrian Embarba will be replaced by Luka Romero (Almeria).
84' Villarreal enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

70' Nice move, nice attempt! Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
70' Great teamplay by Almeria as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Marcos Pena comes onto the pitch so that Dion Lopy (Almeria) can be given a rest.

68' Marc Pubill (Almeria) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Filip Jorgensen. The ball goes behind for a corner. Almeria will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Substitution. Largie Ramazani has come on for Choco Lozano (Almeria).
67' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Dion Lopy (Almeria). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
65' Choco Lozano (Almeria) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His effort goes inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
64' Almeria fail to score from a corner as Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.

63' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
63' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
62' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
61' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) replacing Alfonso Pedraza.
60' The game has come to an end for Dani Parejo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal).
59' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) gets booked for the first time in this match.

55' Fine attempt! Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
54' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias sees the trip by Leo Baptistao (Almeria) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
54' Let's have a look at the offside statistics – 0:2.
54' Alex Baena (Villarreal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
51' A quickly taken corner by Almeria.

51' That was a nice football moment. Jonathan Viera (Almeria) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Filip Jorgensen guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The ball goes out of play. Almeria are awarded a corner kick.
50' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

49' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly over, almost brushing the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
48' Marc Pubill (Almeria) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
47' Neat passing move from Villarreal in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A lofted cross from Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Almeria comes to nothing.
45+1' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Almeria.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

43' What a chance that is! Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.

40' The Villarreal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
33' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' 1 - 1 Choco Lozano (Almeria) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
29' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
28' The Almeria players are exchanging some short passes.

17' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.

16' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
14' The ratio of the ball possession is 76:24.
13' Almeria seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

11' Marc Pubill (Almeria) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but Filip Jorgensen was alert and the score remained the same.
10' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

9' Marc Pubill (Almeria) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Almeria.
7' The cross into the penalty area from Lucas Robertone (Almeria) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Almeria.
